Let the mixture boil further until a thick foam forms on the surface. This helps blend the tea, milk, and cardamom flavors.
Use a metal strainer to pour the finished tea into mugs, filtering out the cardamom pods and tea leaves.

Begin your first measurement. Fill the pipette and carefully release liquid into the beaker, watching the meniscus closely to ensure you reach the correct volume.
Now perform a second measurement. Carefully transfer the water into the beaker, focusing on the graduation marks to maintain high accuracy.
Conduct the final measurement. Lean in close to the pipette to read the meniscus precisely against the graduation lines for an accurate transfer onto the scale.

Hold a flower sprig against the wire base. Starting near the top of the stem, wrap the stretched floral tape tightly around both the stem and the wire.
